description: This file defines a set of React functional components for custom styled AlertDialog UI, built on radix-ui's AlertDialog primitives. It manages dialog structure, overlay, header, footer, title, description, action, and cancel buttons, providing a cohesive component set for alert dialogs in a Next.js project.
